resources.string: Experimental HyperOS animation customization. Diagnostic scaffold only; no animation changes yet.
Your animations. Your flow. Your HyperOS.
This build contains the LSPosed module entry point. Animation controls are not implemented yet. HyperOS 4 compatibility has not been verified.

1. Install and enable HyperDream in LSPosed.

2. Select only the Xiaomi launcher (com.miui.home) in its scope.

3. Reboot your test device.

4. Check LSPosed logs for the HyperDream diagnostic message.
Activation is not detected by this screen. Use LSPosed logs to verify loading. This build does not change animations.
Test on a device you can recover. Disable HyperDream in LSPosed and reboot if problems occur.
